maker: Edo artists, Kingdom of Benin (Igun Eronmwon brass-casting guild)
name: Plaque with Warrior Chief, 16th–17th century
note: Cast brass (lost-wax) relief plaque from the Oba's palace at Benin City, Nigeria. It shows a chief with a coral-beaded helmet and collar, a leopard-tooth necklace and a ceremonial eben sword, with a crescent and rosettes on the ground. The plaque is broken at the edges. I could not match it to one specific museum record, so the exact collection and accession number are unconfirmed.
